name: i2c-write-read-and-write-read
note: eio:i2c's only conformance coverage: no golden block imports it (ABI §13.2 lists none), so this is capability.rs's out_buffer table exercised for real rather than by inspection. i2c_write_read's (buf, cap) sits at argument index 4, unlike state_get and i2c_read's index 2, and its answer lands directly in the emitted template's own slot -- a host consulting the wrong argument position writes into the write-half payload's memory instead and this slot stays four zero bytes, which is not the scripted answer.
